product.description: Fă cunoștință cu Mira, o fetiță simpatică de șapte ani care ține o clinică veterinară in căsuța ei din copac. Mira are un dar neobișnuit ndash; știe să vorbească limba animalelor! Așa poate să afle intotdeauna exact ce-i supără pe micii ei pacienți. Și mereu, cacirc;nd ii ajută, il are alături pe prietenul ei cel mai bun, cățelușul Popic. Citește noile povești emoționante despre pacienții micii doctorițe veterinar! Popic găsește in pădure o bufniță rănită. Zefir, macirc;nzul preferat al Mirei, are o rană la copită și nu poate să alerge. Pe noul cățeluș al celei mai bune prietene il doare o ureche și nu vrea să se lase consultat. Va putea oare Mira să-i ajute pe toți? Și ce oaspete ii face o vizită pe neașteptate? Găsește răspunsul la intrebări in noile povestioare pline de farmec!

This captivating children's book introduces readers to Mira, a sympathetic seven-year-old who runs her very own veterinary clinic nestled in a cozy treehouse. More than just running a practice, Mira possesses an extraordinary gift: she can understand the language of animals!

Join Mira and her loyal friend, Popic (the playful puppy), as they navigate the joys and challenges of pet care, discovering that every animal has a story to tell. This collection of new, emotional tales provides a perfect blend of fun and gentle lessons about empathy and helping others.

*   **The Wounded Owl:** Popic discovers an injured owl deep within the woods, requiring careful attention from the young 'doctor'.
*   **Zefir's Hoof Pain:** Miraâs beloved goat, Zefir, suffers a hoof injury that prevents him from running freely. Can she find a way to help him recover?
*   **The Skeptical Cat:** Mira faces the challenge of helping a new puppy belonging to her best friend who has an earache but is reluctant to undergo examination.

As these mini-adventures unfold, readers will be kept guessing by unexpected visits and heartwarming resolutions. *Mira Èi micii ei pacienÈi* teaches that even when things are challenging, kindness and understanding can heal the deepest woundsâboth physical and emotional. ### Why Parents Love This Book

This book is perfect for children who enjoy stories about animals, empathy, and imaginative play. It not only entertains but also sparks conversations around animal health, compassion, and community care. If your child loves veterinary themes or simply enjoys heartwarming fiction, this adventure awaits them.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is the main premise of the story?**
The book follows Mira, a seven-year-old girl who runs a veterinary clinic in her treehouse and uses her unique ability to communicate with animals to help various injured pets.

**Is this book educational?**
Yes, while highly entertaining, it subtly teaches valuable lessons about empathy, animal care, and the importance of helping others.

**Who are the main characters?**
The primary characters include Mira (the young veterinarian), Popic (her loyal puppy friend), Zefir (a goat patient), and several other local animals.
